newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Boral adjourns AGM over prefs issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Boral adjourns AGM over prefs issue.

text.p: Boral Ltd on Monday adjourned its annual meeting until 3.45 p.m. (0445 GMT) after chairman Peter Cottrell called a poll to amend the company's articles of association.
Cottrell called the poll after a motion amending the articles of association giving authority to issue converting preference shares was defeated on a show of hands.
Cottrell had earlier told the meeting he held proxies representing 216 million shares, 90 percent of which were in favour of the motion.

Cottrell and the board were grilled by shareholders during the three hour meeting, before it was adjourned, over the group's financial performance and environmental issues over its timber logging and woodchipping activities.
At 2.40 p.m. (0340 GMT), Boral shares were three cents lower at A$3.16.
